Description.Text: تشفير من الطرف إلى الطرف، ومفاتيح بأجهزة HSM، وسجل تدقيق غير قابل للتعديل لكل عملية.

تحويلات على مدار الساعة تصل خلال أقل من خمس ثوانٍ، مبنية للتشغيل البيني بين كل بنوك السوق.

Lead.Text: Instant payment infrastructure for the digital economy

Lead.Text: Every engineering decision on our platform comes back to one question: what happens if this system stops for a single minute?

Description.Text: End-to-end encryption, HSM-held keys, and an immutable audit trail for every transaction.
A horizontal architecture handling millions of transactions an hour with no downtime and no latency drift.
Documented APIs and ISO 20022 standards make integrating with any existing system a matter of days, not months.
Engineering teams across three time zones, with contractually guaranteed SLAs.
Irrevocable final settlement for high-value payments, with real-time liquidity management and an extended operating window.
Round-the-clock transfers arriving in under five seconds, built for interoperability across every bank in the market.
